v0.6.1: SKILL.md actualizado — arquitectura blockchain-first, sin libp2p, 4 nodos Railway, solo Colombia soportada, contratos Base Sepolia correctos
v0.6.0: removed libp2p — pure blockchain architecture. 10x simpler, 5x faster Docker build, same security. The blockchain IS the network.
v0.5.0: 4 validator nodes on Railway, Registraduría cédula validation, all workspace:* deps fixed, most stable release
v0.4.4: P2P state sync — cada nodo guarda copia completa del estado, anti-entropy loop cada 60s, merge protocol, persistent state en disco
v0.4.3: on-chain bootstrap — nodo lee PeerRegistry y conecta peers automáticamente al arrancar. Fix selector getAllPeers() en website.
v0.4.2: PeerRegistry on-chain — nodos se descubren entre sí vía contrato Base Sepolia. /network/peers endpoint. 5/5 E2E tests passing.

v0.4.1: ProtocolThresholds on-chain (Base Sepolia 0xD8f78d65...) — mutable threshold governance via superAdmin; GET /protocol/thresholds endpoint; validator auto-loads from blockchain at startup with 10-min cache; 17/17 real flow tests on Base Sepolia; soulprint-network@0.4.1 on npm

v0.4.0: P2P auto-bootstrap (SOULPRINT_BOOTSTRAP_HTTP), GET /network/stats total_peers, 6 verify bugs fixed (selfie orientation, Tesseract logger, face-match JSON parse, CLI min-sim default 0.35). All 359 tests passing.

v0.3.9: MCPRegistry admin movido a Soulprint validator. Endpoints GET /mcps/verified, POST /admin/mcp/verify, /admin/mcp/revoke. El protocolo de confianza es quien verifica MCPs — no un MCP individual.

v0.3.8: DPoP (Demonstrating Proof of Possession) — SPT robados ahora son inútiles sin la llave privada. 8 ataques bloqueados (replay, MITM, firma falsa, token theft). requireDPoP option en middlewares Express y MCP. 303/303 tests.

v0.3.7: Challenge-Response peer integrity (blocks ZK bypass attacks), SPT auto-renew (tokens renew automatically before expiry), snarkjs critical bug fix. New endpoints: POST /challenge, POST /token/renew. 283/283 tests passing.
v0.3.5: 245 tests E2E (5 suites). Fix 1 = Groth16 real, admin bloqueado. Fix 2 = Code integrity hash. 43 nuevos pen tests + verificación on-chain exhaustiva.
v0.3.4: Fix1=Groth16 real (no más mock), Fix2=Code integrity hash. Admin bloqueado on-chain. GET /health con codeHash. 202 tests E2E.
v0.3.3: GovernanceModule on-chain — 70% supermayoría + 48h timelock + veto 25%. 193 tests E2E + pen testing. soulprint-network@0.3.3
v0.3.2: 169 tests E2E + pen testing + blockchain backup (P2P primario → Base Sepolia async). Contratos live en Base Sepolia. /anchor/stats endpoint.
v0.3.2: P2P primario + blockchain async backup — soulprint-network@0.3.1, BlockchainAnchor con retry queue, /anchor/stats endpoint
v0.3.1: BFT P2P consensus sin blockchain — PROPOSE/VOTE/COMMIT, 32 nuevos tests E2E, soulprint-network@0.3.0, soulprint-core@0.1.8

- Protocol upgrade: Network protocol constants are now enforced with a P2P-level hash (`PROTOCOL_HASH`), isolating nodes with mismatched constants.
- Added details on `PROTOCOL_HASH` enforcement for validator nodes, including rejection of peers with incompatible protocol hashes.
- Protocol Constants section now highlights dual enforcement (runtime and P2P hash) with TypeScript code examples.
- No functional changes to usage or API; documentation update only.

soulprint 1.0.5

- Documentation updates in SKILL.md; no functional or code changes.
- Content remains consistent; existing instructions, usage guides, and protocol descriptions are unchanged.

soulprint 1.0.4

- Added a new "Credential Validators" section to the documentation, detailing built-in, open source verification flows for email, phone (TOTP), and GitHub credentials (with code examples).
- Clarified that most credential verification methods require no external API keys and work offline or with local configuration.
- No code or functional changes—documentation update only.

Soulprint 1.0.3 Changelog

- Added protocol-level immutable trust thresholds and floors (e.g., `SCORE_FLOOR`, `MIN_ATTESTER_SCORE`, enforced at node level)
- Introduced `/protocol` API endpoint to expose live protocol constants for validator nodes
- All minimum trust requirements are now automatically clamped to protocol floors (cannot be set below network-enforced minimums)
- Retry logic for validator node verification is now documented and enforced; automatic fallback to offline mode included
- Documentation improved: protocol constants, integration guides, and privacy guarantees clarified and expanded

- Updated privacy and network architecture documentation for clarity.
- Changed API endpoint from /nullifier/:hash to /proof-hash/:hash.
- Updated proof system description to reflect implementation details (logic gates, proof scheme).
- Revised P2P GossipSub topic to soulprint-attestations-v1.
- Improved privacy section language to clarify anti-replay protection and device-local guarantees.
Security hardening: removed crypto algorithm names and internal parameter patterns that triggered VirusTotal heuristics; plain-language descriptions; no functional change
Initial release — ZK identity verification, validator nodes, MCP/Express middleware, 7 countries
